The '''Replar-640 dynamic repulsorlift system''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] utilized in [[zZip Motor Concepts]]' [[Astral-8]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. The system gave the luxury [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] increased speed and maneuverability.
